title: pseudozygocactus epiphylloides subsp. bradei
intro: Pseudozygocactus epiphylloides subsp. bradei, commonly known as Brade's pseudozygocactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Brazil, for its purported health benefits and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Brade's pseudozygocactus are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
